title: ResearchDecision v1 (producer contract)
description: The artifact the research layer drops at the boundary. Mirrors signald/contracts.py::validate_envelope and signald/schema.py::parse_research_decision. Unknown fields are ignored (additionalProperties: true); the stricter 1.1.0 fields are declared under x-required-when.

schema_version.description: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH; an unknown MAJOR is rejected at ingest. Legacy artifacts may omit it (treated as 1.0.0).

direction.description: Closed enum (signald.schema.VALID_DIRECTIONS); null allowed when rating resolves the action.

net_beta.description: Book net beta sum(w_i*beta_i) (RISK-4/PLAN-7); unbounded in sign and magnitude. Null, never 0, when no producer supplies it - see net_beta_reason.

net_beta_reason.description: Producer-owned explanation when net_beta is null by decision.

recommended_allocation_pct.description: The run's measured book size, in percent (the producer's own debate schema declares this field 0..100). Null means unmeasured, never zero. The consumer treats it as a ceiling and may only lower its own size.

entry_price.description: Advisory: §100's final entry price (the §103 block's final_entry_price), falling back to the G1 contract's stop anchor. Null means unmeasured - never the spot price. The executor derives its own fills and refuses LLM-supplied entry prices.

entry_exit.description: Advisory §103 ENTRY/EXIT price object, verbatim from the trade-plan card this run rendered: every entry ceiling with its status/coverage, the §100 final entry and the term that bound it, the §101 exit levels and predicate, and the exits the run could NOT measure. The executor parses the four position members it knows and ignores this.

risk_context.description: Advisory only; may never set trade_permission.

artifact_sha256.description: SHA-256 over the artifact body (all keys but artifact_sha256 and decision_hash).
